title: Tianji Displaying Its Might
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought his goal of intimidating the petty ones had been achieved, a gaze that pierced through the boundaries pressed against his back like a thorn. He turned sharply—it was Ling Yuan's line of sight, crossing through the spatial barrier, locking onto him tightly.

text.content:
Inside the Council Hall, the atmosphere froze like ink.

It had been three days since the conspiracy of the Five Elders' remnant forces had failed. The entire Tianqing Sect remained immersed in an eerie calm. On the surface, there was the relief of having escaped disaster, but undercurrents churned—everyone knew that behind that conspiracy stood the Elder Pavilion.

And the master of the Elder Pavilion was Ling Yuan.

At this moment, Chen Ji stood in the corner of the Council Hall, dressed in gray robes, utterly unremarkable. He lowered his head, seemingly counting the patterns on the floor tiles, yet a faint, barely perceptible smile played at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: Esteemed ones, although the Five Elders have been brought to justice, the sect's affairs cannot go无人主持 for even a day.

text.content:
A dignified voice, aged yet commanding, echoed from the depths of the Elder Pavilion. Ling Yuan did not appear in person, yet his voice resonated as if by each listener's ear, striking fear into the hearts of those present.

Chen Ji raised his gaze slightly.

Here it comes.

This old sect master seemed to be discussing sect affairs, but in truth, he was probing. The Five Elders were his pawns, and after the conspiracy failed, he needed a new piece to stir up these muddy waters. And Chen Ji, this 'waste,' was clearly the easiest choice—after all, everyone knew that the reason the Five Elders' conspiracy had failed that day was entirely because this waste had 'coincidentally' appeared at the crucial moment.

dialogue.content: I propose that before the Sect Competition, Chen Ji temporarily assume the duties of the Five Elders and participate in sect deliberations.

text.content:
The moment these words fell, an uproar swept through the Council Hall.

A servant disciple, a recognized waste, actually participate in sect deliberations? Wasn't this the height of absurdity?

Some whispered amongst themselves: 'What is the old sect master thinking? Showing off? Or... does he have some deeper purpose?'

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, a cold smile forming in his heart.

Ling Yuan's move was viciously effective. If he refused, it would be ungrateful, and he could be labeled 'harboring ulterior motives' at any moment. If he accepted, those consumed by jealousy would inevitably seek ways to make things difficult for him, and when mistakes occurred, it would be utter ruin.

And regardless of his choice, Ling Yuan would use this opportunity to see through his cards.

What a superb scheme of killing with a borrowed knife.

dialogue.content: Old sect master, this may be inappropriate. Although Brother Chen Ji has rendered minor service, his qualifications are still shallow. To rashly participate in deliberations would make it difficult to win the trust of the people.

text.content:
Su Qingyao stepped forward, a trace of anxiety flickering in her beautiful eyes.

She didn't know Chen Ji's true capabilities, but she instinctively felt something was off about this matter. She had heard about the old sect master's methods, and such 'grace' surely concealed schemes.

However, Ling Yuan's voice rang out again, carrying undeniable authority:

Oh? Qualifications? Then in the view of Senior Fellow Su, what constitutes qualifications? Rendering great service doesn't count as qualification? Must one wait until one's hair turns white following the seniority system?

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Ling Yuan's schemes?

choices.description: Since avoidance is impossible, better to take the initiative. Display part of the Tianji Record's abilities before everyone, intimidate the petty ones, and make them retreat.
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the Entire Assembly, Buying Time to Catch One's Breath
choices.risk_hint: Once the Tianji Record's abilities are exposed, it will inevitably attract the attention and covetousness of various forces.

text.content:
Chen Ji let out a light laugh and stepped out from the corner.

'The old sect master's generous favor, this disciple should not refuse. However...'

He surveyed his surroundings, his gaze sweeping across those whispering faces one by one, the curve at the corner of his mouth growing more pronounced.

'Since the esteemed ones have doubts about this disciple's 'qualifications,' this disciple dares to prove himself.'

choices.text: Continue Playing the Pig to Eat the Tiger
choices.description: Humbly accept, but deliberately perform even more incompetent in deliberations, causing Ling Yuan to lower his guard.
choices.visible_reward: Hide Your Trump Cards, Bide Your Time
choices.risk_hint: May suffer more humiliation, and Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious.

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head, putting on an expression of utter nervousness.

'The old sect master's elevation, this disciple... this disciple is unworthy. But since the old sect master has spoken, this disciple will spare no effort to serve the sect.'

As he spoke, his voice trembled slightly, his gaze darting about—a perfect picture of a country bumpkin who had never seen the world.

Seeing this, the crowd couldn't help but reveal hints of contempt.

choices.text: Set a Trap to Mislead the Crowd
choices.description: On the surface display some 'minor abilities,' but deliberately guide the crowd toward incorrect speculations, concealing the true abilities of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: If the misinformation fails, it will反而 expose more flaws.

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes rolled as an idea struck him.

'Old sect master, esteemed brothers and sisters.' He began, his voice calm. 'This disciple does indeed possess some... minor talents, but certainly nothing miraculous.'

He deliberately paused, surveying his surroundings.

'This disciple received a fortuitous encounter in childhood and is extremely sensitive to spiritual energy. I can vaguely perceive some... events that are about to occur.'

No matter which path is chosen, fate has already pushed Chen Ji to the forefront.

At this moment, the gazes of everyone in the Council Hall fell upon this gray-robed youth. Some were curious, some disdainful, some gleeful.

Chen Ji simply stood there quietly, eyes lowered, as if waiting for something.

The Tianji Record in his Mental Sea pulsed with warmth.

In three breaths, an Inner Sect disciple will step forward to make things difficult for him.

In five breaths, someone will knock over a teacup.

In ten breaths, Ling Yuan will speak again, proposing an even more exacting condition.

These three things, Chen Ji had already seen clearly.

And he merely needed to let them come to pass, one by one.

One.

Two.

Three.

'Since Brother Chen is being so modest, why not answer this brother's question first.' A sly-faced Inner Sect disciple stepped forward, his smile not reaching his eyes. 'I heard Brother Chen has borrowed many classics from the Scripture Pavilion recently. I wonder what insights Brother has gained?'

At this, low laughter immediately rippled through the surroundings.

The classics in the Scripture Pavilion were not随便谁都 able to borrow. One needed contribution points. And Chen Ji, a servant disciple, where would he get contribution points? This was clearly exposing his shortcomings in public.

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed. Just as she was about to speak, she saw Chen Ji had already smiled faintly.

Chen Ji did not answer that Inner Sect disciple's question. Instead, he suddenly turned toward another direction—where a servant carrying tea was walking past with a tea tray.

'This brother.' Chen Ji called out, his voice not loud, yet clearly carrying throughout the entire Council Hall. 'The teacup in your hand has a crack on the rim. In three more steps, the tea will spill.'

The servant froze, instinctively looking down to check—just then, his foot不知被谁绊了一下, his body lurched, and the teacup in his hand indeed flew out!

Tea splashed, porcelain shards scattered.

But strangely, not a single drop of tea fell on the floor. Instead, it all landed in the nearest potted plant, not splashing onto anyone.

dialogue.content: Four breaths ago, what did I say again?

text.content:
The Council Hall fell into dead silence.

That sly-faced Inner Sect disciple's smile froze. He had clearly done nothing just now—how could the teacup really have broken? And it just happened to match Chen Ji's words exactly?

Coincidence?

Impossible—coincidence!

'You... how did you know?' He pointed at Chen Ji, his voice trembling slightly.

Chen Ji didn't look at him. Instead, he continued:

'In two more breaths, someone will knock over the ink.'

The moment his words fell, another Inner Sect disciple let out a startled cry. The ink bottle in his hand somehow slipped, black ink splashing across the floor.

Now, everyone could no longer sit still.

From the depths of the Elder Pavilion, that aged voice rang out once more, but this time carrying a heavy quality beyond the last.

'Chen Ji, what is... this ability of yours?'

This time, Ling Yuan's tone was no longer playful, but carried an undeniable shock.

Chen Ji raised his head, directly facing the direction of the Elder Pavilion for the first time. His gaze was calm as still water, yet seemed capable of piercing through countless barriers to meet that hidden gaze.

'Responding to the old sect master, this disciple also doesn't know what this is.' His voice was neither humble nor overbearing. 'This disciple only knows that from long ago, this disciple has been able to vaguely 'see' some things that are about to happen.'

He paused, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly.

'I simply didn't expect it to be so accurate today.'

The moment his words fell, the air in the Council Hall seemed to freeze.

Foreseeing the future?

These four words struck like thunder in everyone's minds.

In the cultivation world, those who could foresee the future were extremely rare, and every person with such an ability was a legendary figure whose name shook the world—either a reincarnated great one, one blessed by heaven, or one bearing great fortune.

And now, a servant disciple, a recognized waste, actually claimed he could foresee the future?

How could this be?

Yet the two incidents just now had already come true, leaving no room for disbelief.

choice.prompt: Amidst everyone's shock, should Chen Ji continue to demonstrate?

choices.description: Seize the momentum and predict an even bigger event—perhaps the condition Ling Yuan is about to propose—completely intimidate the entire assembly.
choices.visible_reward: Completely solidify the prophecy ability, causing Ling Yuan to hesitate
choices.risk_hint: Consume Heavenly Fate, and may provoke stronger enemies

text.content:
Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally landing on the direction of the Elder Pavilion.

'Old sect master.' He began, his voice calm. 'This disciple dares to make another prediction.'

He took a deep breath.

'What you are about to say is that this disciple should face Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect in the competition three days from now.'

choices.description: Having intimidated the petty ones, there's no need to continue exposing oneself. Know when to pull back, leaving suspense.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the Opportunity to Deepen the Intimidation
choices.visible_reward: Retain More Trump Cards, Making It Harder for Enemies to Gauge One's Depth
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may seize the opportunity to make a move

text.content:
Chen Ji smiled faintly, stepping back.

'This disciple has shown off.' He cupped his hands in a bow. 'As for what exactly this ability is, even this disciple cannot say clearly. Perhaps Heaven has given me this blessing, or perhaps it was just a stroke of luck.'

He lowered his eyes, his expression reaching the pinnacle of humility.

'If the old sect master has no other instructions, this disciple will take his leave.'

No matter the choice, the gears of Chen Ji's destiny have already begun to turn.

Deep within the Elder Pavilion, Ling Yuan's eyes narrowed slightly. His spiritual sense, like an invisible thread, crossed through space, quietly approaching Chen Ji.

However, just as the thread was about to touch Chen Ji—

In the Void, a rift suddenly tore open!

The rift was deep as an abyss, and within it seemed to be a massive eye gazing in this direction. That eye had no pupil, only endlessly swirling star rivers, each rotation seeming to depict the ultimate truths of heaven and earth.

Eye of Heavenly Way!

In the Council Hall, everyone simultaneously felt a vast pressure descend from the heavens. That pressure was irresistible, unstoppable—as if if that eye gazed lightly upon them, they would turn to dust.

Even Ling Yuan's spiritual sense was repelled in that instant.

And the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly vibrated violently.

A cold voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind.

That voice held no emotion, no temperature—only boundless authority and cold indifference.

What are you doing?

The Tianji Record is not for you to play games with mortals.

Every glimpse of heavenly secrets diminishes your lifespan. I warn you, do not abuse it.

Otherwise—

Before the voice could finish, that eye had already vanished, the Void rift healing as if nothing had ever happened.

But Chen Ji knew it was no hallucination.

The Eye of Heavenly Way truly existed.

The Council Hall fell into dead silence.

The scene just witnessed was too shocking. Everyone was still lost in shock, unable to回过神来. That eye that appeared out of thin air, that supreme pressure... what exactly was that?

Only Chen Ji knew.

That was the Eye of Heavenly Way.

The true master of the Tianji Record.

And also his greatest enemy.

Yet at this moment, he had no time to contemplate these things. Because he felt a yet more dangerous gaze, piercing through space, locking onto him tightly.

That was Ling Yuan's gaze.

Carrying scrutiny, wariness, and an inescapable greed.

Chen Ji felt that gaze, his heart tightening.

He knew that today's events had already reached Ling Yuan's ears. No matter how he explained, he could no longer dispel this old sect master's suspicions.

But this was within his expectations.

Playing the pig to eat the tiger was never a long-term strategy. A true strong one needs to bare their fangs at critical moments, letting enemies know—the price of crossing them.

Today, he had succeeded.

Although the price was drawing the warning of the Eye of Heavenly Way. Although the price was making Ling Yuan even more wary of him. He had successfully intimidated the petty ones, buying himself breathing room.

However, this was merely the beginning.

Ling Yuan would not let this rest.

The Eye of Heavenly Way would not sit by idly.

And Chen Ji's chess game was just beginning.

Just as Chen Ji thought all of this had ended, that gaze piercing through boundaries grew even stronger.

He raised his head sharply, directly facing the direction of the Elder Pavilion.

There, he could see nothing. But he knew Ling Yuan was there.

A pair of deep eyes, passing through countless barriers, staring fixedly at him.

That gaze held no anger, no killing intent—only a chilling calm.

It was an experienced hunter surveying the prey he had set his sights upon.

Chen Ji's mouth lifted slightly, responding with a faint smile.

The game has just begun.
